title: Families and Friends
bigQuestion: Who are your family and friends?
pages: Student Book pp.7–15；Grammar & Vocabulary WS U1；Phonics WS U1（The Alphabet）；Reading Comprehension WS U1
unitObjectives: 掌握家庭词汇 14 个（含 uncle/aunt/cousin/parents/son/daughter）
会用 verb be 肯定/否定/疑问（am/is/are, isn't/aren't）
能读短篇并回答细节题（Jake/Mandy/Kim）
能写 3–5 句介绍家人，拼写本单元高频词
自然拼读：字母表与首音（m/f/s/c 等）
